title: Fallout 1 remake in Unity
author: XSpettro101X
selftext:
https://youtu.be/zMW78u4KUxw?is=RYNia18lEd1kgAVc

Rebuilding original Fallout in Unity, first person. Just me and Claude.

Code: Claude Code + Unity MCP. I review and fix everything myself. 

Example: an early cave room looked like smooth concrete instead of rock. Turned out to be a mesh/shader issue, fixed it with a triplanar shader and a proper normal map, and now it applies to every cave in the game.

Art: fully AI generated. I'm not an artist, so the choice was either that or placeholder boxes forever. Figured I'd just say it upfront instead of waiting for someone to ask.

The game is and will be free forever, no donations either. You will require the original game, as it reads the files in runtime.

Happy to talk more about any part of this if people want details.
